fields.FIR_Description: On 2025-09-24 around 21:00 hrs, it was reported that a group of persons allegedly attacked the complainant at Kalai Layout Parking Area, causing injuries that required treatment. Contact details given by the complainant, Jothi Selvi, include the number 9000000436. The complainant alleged that Karthik Velan may be involved and provided the mobile number 9000000188. Abirami Sekar (9000000186) noticed the incident and may be able to provide a statement. Items referenced in the complaint: photographs and physical documents.
fields.Modus_Operandi: Several persons reportedly attacked the victim in a secluded stretch.
